fact: Since 2024 Zimbabwe's Ministry of Health and Child Care, with the Global Fund and UNDP, has run a large-scale TB screening project in Gweru using Infervision's AI chest X-ray reading (InferRead) on ultra-portable X-ray units, with over 2,600 people screened daily.
title: Boosting TB Dectection in Rural Zimbabwe | Using Infervision's AI and Ultra-Portable X-Ray Devices (InferAir)
